title: ECG-coded hypertrophy–chronotropic shortfall interaction fails to establish incremental cross-hospital diagnostic value
abstract: In retrospective Cleveland-to-VA Long Beach transfer (303 source,137 eligible target patients),adding ECG-coded probable-LVH × age-predicted exercise-HR shortfall to flexible routine and chronotropic main effects changed Brier score from 0.203179 to 0.205044;baseline-minus-augmented gain -0.001865,1000 source-refit/target-bootstrap95% interval [-0.032010,0.010683]. Incremental predictive benefit was not demonstrated;this is not equivalence or evidence against physiological structural–chronotropic coupling. Source CV also worsened. Previously exposed historical cohorts,marked resting-ECG distribution shift,and unmeasured medication/effort restrict interpretation. AI authored;self-checks are not independent review.
